run-boundary.ownership: README sections 2 and 6: each C owner retains its own state; broker owns world; evaluator owns post-run analysis.
run-boundary.authority: README sections 2 and 4: exact public mission grants only; model has no tool/operator authority; evaluator receives artifacts only after closure.
run-boundary.shape_versions: SOURCE_PINS and RUN_CONFIG: native source/public schemas retained; new intent/image/clock schemas proposed and block contract acceptance; exact processor/model versions required.
run-boundary.identity_scope: Run/session/workspace plus issuer/source/epoch/document/occurrence, exact selectors and hashes; duplicate payload is not duplicate occurrence.
run-boundary.time_order: README clock contract: simulation year, source time, receipt, commit and knowledge cut distinct; inference takes a pinned cut; offline transfer after closure.
run-boundary.delivery_idempotency: README restart contract: original stable request/body and operation replay; changed reuse conflicts; no assumed inference HTTP deduplication.
run-boundary.commit_recovery: README section 2: no distributed transaction; write-ahead intent, broker replay, C1 occurrence commit then C0 ack; unresolved workers require trusted reconciliation.
run-boundary.retention: Private durable run volumes and acquired bytes through analysis; no runtime garbage collection of supporting evidence; capacity yields. Secrets/databases excluded from Git.
run-boundary.resource_limits: RUN_CONFIG proposed root budgets and stricter owner/public page/chunk/job caps; all prompt/image/helper/failed work charged or unknown.
run-boundary.errors: Explicit denied/unsupported/unavailable/conflict/partial/capacity/timeout/uncertain completion; no semantic answer fabrication or silent fallback.
run-boundary.feedback_grounding: Public acquired records remain reports/simulation observations; model/teacher/derived/simulated output is not independent external evidence; no evaluator-to-runtime feedback.

facets.ownership: C4 owns pinned inquiry/jobs and inference journal. vLLM owns preprocessing/generation only. C1 durably records exact returned wire bytes; C3 alone owns candidate admission.
facets.shape_versions: edi-c4/0.5.2 native acceptance unchanged; gateway 1.2 exposes reference semantics. XGrammar serving envelope defers only known map-key length checks to native validation; oneOf approximation remains subject to complete native checks.
facets.identity_scope: Job/inquiry/workspace/context SHA and exact messages digest remain bound; transport fills only native identity, attribution and usage. Model-supplied conflicting identities are rejected. Inputs remain authored/generated occurrences.
facets.time_order: C4 freezes the original context/revision before count and dispatch. Count precedes inference; C1 wire commit precedes strict response acceptance. No retroactive evidence cut or prospective empirical forecast is implied.
facets.delivery_idempotency: Atomic C4 claim permits one inference. Exact completed replay is read from the journal. Unknown completion is not retried. Tokenization may repeat as a non-generation preprocessing operation; it cannot dispatch an action.
facets.commit_recovery: C1 original wire and C4 gateway result retained; two completed calls reopened without inference. Semantic import rejection leaves C0 turn pending/C4 awaiting import. No automatic retry or partial acceptance. Explicit rejection/correction state is proposed, not implemented.
facets.retention: All four current trials exported and hash/archive verified before advancement; 48 files/17 DB copies retained on desktop, selected evidence/manifests in Git. Earlier session-loss records remain unavailable. No whole-application or broker restore qualification.
facets.resource_limits: 16K FP16/TP2 T4x2, one image max65536 pixels. Native input12288/output2048; C0 output4096, four turns/65536 total tokens/600 seconds; serving timeout120 seconds. Measured failed calls counted; first returned usage, full aggregate cost and energy unknown.
facets.errors: Initial unsupported grammar and invalid rivals retained; final native cases pass. C0 rejected a test targeting API names with no hypotheses or operation proposals. Invalid content is never accepted to create progress. Provider-unknown completion stays unresolved.
facets.feedback_grounding: C2 features and Qwen text remain attributed generated candidates, never independent empirical corroboration. Selected protocol questions are generic Meadows questions, not forest hints. C3 promotion, teacher, C5/C6 feedback and world intervention are not exercised here. Two accepted descriptions remain generated candidate hypotheses, not independent empirical evidence. C0 supplied no information-seeking operation despite the available public catalogue; causation of that behavior is unisolated.

feedback_reviews.analysis: EDI's selected exposure, optional correlated teacher critique and world interventions form a delayed learning loop. Teacher has the same cut and cannot act or corroborate itself. C1 originals, C3 candidates, generated outputs and actual constructed observations remain distinct. Broker replay and atomic first-dispatch claims prevent repeated admitted work; missing provider completion retains unknown cost. No evaluator return path. Full host/egress/isolation bounds remain unqualified. The new count/generation feedback compares exact admitted prompt count with actual usage, rejecting disagreement. Correlated source features/model output do not become independent evidence. Shared-uid Kaggle diagnostics are not a hard security boundary.
